title: Raw rationalization of an integral compact-support scalar isomorphism
statement: Let $K_0,\ell,f:X\to Y,c$ satisfy the finite-type and separated hypotheses of [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action], with $\ell$ invertible in $K_0$. Let $E\subseteq L$ be finite coefficient subfields of an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Every integral natural isomorphism $b:F_ET^Y\simeq T^XF_L$, without any mixed-unit normalization hypothesis, induces a rational natural isomorphism between the corresponding compact-support/scalar-transition composites [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi]. Each component is heterogeneously equal to the image of $b_K$ under the specified raw integral-to-rational localization. The heterogeneous equality only transports the literal object equalities in the rational transition specification.

source.place: Compact-support and final paragraphs; normalized scalar isomorphisms proof steps 6

proof.text: Construct the component isomorphism by localizing b.app K.obj and conjugating by the literal rational transition object equalities. Prove naturality on each pure tensor using the prescribed rational transition and finite-action pure-tensor formulas, bilinear composition and integral naturality. Tensor induction (zero, pure tensor, sum) extends naturality to every map. The two localized inverse equations give the natural isomorphism; the construction gives its HEq component formula. The private generic localizeIso and map_heq helpers implement these endpoint transports. The private rationalScalarIsoOfFields helper performs the calculation for abstract finite coefficient fields before specializing to the specified universe-normalized coefficient fields, keeping their representation opaque to the calculation.

theorem sfCompactSupportRationalScalarIso
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l Ω) (h : E ≤ L)
    (b : sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l K₀ hl c (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) ⋙
        integralTransition l Ω Y E L h ≅
      integralTransition l Ω X E L h ⋙
        sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l K₀ hl c (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)) :
    ∃ β : sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l K₀ hl c (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) ⋙
          transition l Ω Y E L h ≅
        transition l Ω X E L h ⋙
          sfCompactSupportFiniteFunctor l K₀ hl c (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L),
        ∀ K : Stage l Ω X E, HEq (β.hom.app K)
          ((sfRationalConstructibleLocalization l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) Y).map
            (b.hom.app K.obj))
